name: biff-scheduler
description: BIFF 电影节排片工具，支持 IFFDAY 登录和账号同步

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run test -w @biff/web && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler dev -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && npm run deploy -w @biff/web && npm run deploy -w @biff/api
